title: Settings & Advanced
markdown:
**What it is:** The settings that live outside the day-to-day menu: whether the Executive is running and how it sounds, your notifications, what it knows about you, who Open Executive is for, the version, and the admin and power-user tools under **Advanced**. What the Executive may do as you or on its own is not here: it is under **Delegate** in the main menu (see the Delegate section of this guide).

**What it does:**

- Opens on a page of settings in three groups: **You and your Executive** (**Your Executive**, **Notifications**, **About you**), **Company** (**Workspace**) and **More** (**Advanced**, **About**). Each group is a card with a row per page. Each row says, where it can, how things stand now, and otherwise what's on its page: running or paused and the voice, your quiet hours, whether notes are on and how long they last, Personal or Team and the time zone, how many tools are under Advanced, the version and whether an update is available.
- **Notifications** and **About you** have rows only for someone on the People list.
- Click a row to open its page. The **Settings** link at the top of each page takes you back.

**How to use:**

1. Click **Settings** at the bottom of the sidebar. (On a phone, open the menu with the button at the top left; Settings is at its bottom.)
2. Click a row to open that page.
3. On **Advanced**, click a row to open that tool.

**Your Executive:**

- **Pause everything**: shows **Running** or **Paused**. Click **Pause…**, add a reason if you like (up to 200 characters), and click **Pause Executive**. **Cancel** closes the form.
- While paused, the card shows since when, who paused it, the reason and how many held actions will run when you resume. **Resume** is shown only to the principal. Anyone who can sign in can pause.
- **Always does on its own**: what it does with no switch: the morning brief and evening digest, nudges, looking over your day, research and monitoring, and looking back at its chats (what it fixes, what it got wrong and what it learned from that go to **Pulse**). Pause stops these too.
- A line under it points to **Delegate** for Take the lead, booking meetings and what it sends as you.
- **Voice**: pick the voice the Executive answers you in. It saves when you pick.

**Pausing the Executive:**

- Open **Settings → Your Executive**, or **Pause or resume the Executive** in the account menu (the **⋯** next to your name at the bottom of the sidebar).
- While paused, the Executive starts nothing on its own: no briefs, nudges, monitoring, inbox processing, workflow timers or Take the lead. An amber banner appears on every page, and a note on Your Executive says nothing there runs until you resume.
- Chat and direct messages (Slack, Telegram, Discord, Google Chat) still get answers. Anything you tap **Send** or **Approve** on still goes.
- Nothing is lost. Work that falls due during the pause waits, and runs when you click **Resume**.

**Notifications:**

- Each person sets their own. Only people on the People list can set them; anyone else is told so.
- **Quiet hours**: a switch, then **From**, **To** and **Days** (**Every day**, or **Weekdays (weekends quiet all day)**). Click **Save quiet hours** after changing the times. What the Executive would send you on its own (nudges, check-ins on your work, alerts) waits until your quiet hours end. Replies when you message it still come straight away. Times are in your time zone; a link offers your browser's zone if it differs.
- **How things reach you**: **As they happen**, or **In my briefs**. For the owner, **In my briefs** adds held messages to the next morning brief or end-of-day digest under "While you were away". For anyone else, they are sent together in one message when the briefs go out.
- **Let urgent things through**: on, reminders about things waiting on your approval and critical alerts reach you right away, even in quiet hours or when you get things in your briefs. A question a workflow is waiting on you to answer always comes straight away.
- A line at the top says how many messages are waiting, if any.

**About you:**

- Everything the Executive keeps about you. Each person sees only their own.
- **Your profile**: what it has learned from your chats and replies, with your notes. Only you see it. It is read-only, and it is hidden when long-term memory is off.
- **Share my work style with the team**: off by default. On, the Executive shares how you work (your role, your focus, how you like updates, your working style) with teammates when they ask, and uses it to help them work with you.
- **Keep track of what happens**: on, it keeps private notes of what you tell it in chat, and of replies it drafted that you send. **Keep my notes for** picks a shorter time for your own notes. **See your notes** opens them on Pulse.
- **How long notes last**: notes are forgotten after this unless their person pins them. The owner picks it **For everyone**; everyone else sees what it is.

**Workspace:**

- **Using Open Executive**: **Personal** or **Team**. Picking the other one asks you to confirm and says what changes, with **Switch to Personal** / **Switch to Team** and **Cancel**:
  - **Personal** pauses department check-ins and renames **Company** in the sidebar to **You**, with **Goals** (grouped by area), **People** and your profile. There is no Departments tab. Nothing is deleted: your departments stay, as the areas your goals are grouped by.
  - **Team** brings back **Company** with its **Departments** tab and their daily check-ins.
  - A persona you customised in Council stays in place in either mode.
- **Your role** (Personal only): which describes you best (**Owner / founder**, **Executive inside an organisation**, **Independent or fractional** or **Other**), your title, who you report to, what you're responsible for and what you're measured on. Every field is optional. Click **Save role**, or **Discard changes**. The Executive uses it to fit its advice to your job. It stays saved if you switch to Team.
- **Time zone**: when your morning brief, end-of-day digest and reflection arrive, and how the Executive reads "tomorrow at 9". Pick a zone, **Follow server default**, or click **Use this browser's time zone**. It saves when you pick.
- **Company email domains** (under **Advanced** at the bottom, principal only): mail from these domains matches a teammate by the part before the @, so anna+invoices@ reaches the Anna already on your People list. Someone new writing from one is suggested as a teammate; you still confirm them. It follows your own address until you set it. **Save** keeps the list; **Use my address** goes back to your own address.
- Only the principal can change the mode, role and time zone.
- During first setup, **Who is this for?** asks Personal or Team. You can change it here later, and add teammates any time from **People**.

**Advanced:**

- The tools that open their own screen, grouped by what you'd use them for:
  - **Check & diagnose**: **Setup status**, **Audit log**, **Token usage**.
  - **Configure**: **Agent Council**, **Custom tools**, **Company Simulator**, **Client Companies**.
  - **Learn**: **User Guide**, **Architecture**.
- **Setup status**: a light for each part of your setup and what to do about anything that isn't working.
- **Audit log**: a searchable record of everything the Executive did: each chat, each question it passed to an expert, each tool it used and each scheduled job.
- **Token usage**: what the AI has cost: the total, each day and each model.
- **Agent Council**: choose how thorough answers are, and change each agent's model, instructions and the Executive's voice.
- **Custom tools**: tools the Executive built when it didn't have the one it needed. Only the account owner sees them. Each has a switch, **Use in workflows**, and **Details, versions and runs** with **Use this one** to go back a version.
- **Company Simulator**: load a demo company, save a copy of your data, or have AI make up a new one.
- **Client Companies**: for fractional work: switch between the companies you work for.
- **User Guide**: this guide. **Architecture**: the technical reference for how the system is built.

**Checking your setup:**

- Open **Settings → Advanced → Setup status**. Each part gets a light: green **Working**, amber **Needs attention**, red **Not working**, grey **Not set up** (optional).
- The lights: **Sign-in**, **AI model**, **Company setup**, **Owner**, **The Executive's email address**, **API protection**, **Email (Gmail)**, **Your own mailbox (Act as me)**, **Slack**, **Discord**, **Telegram**, **Google Chat**, **Daily schedule**, **Daily brief** and **Long-term memory (Honcho)**. The page lists the ones that need you first.
- It tests for real: the AI key, and each chat app's token with a quick call that sends nothing. For each chat app it also checks whether anyone on your People list can reach it, and shows when the last message arrived.
- Anything that isn't green says what to do in plain words, with a link when the fix is on another page. After you change a setting and restart the app, click **Check again**.

**About:**

- Shows the version this install runs, and whether a newer one is out. When one is, **What's new** and **How to upgrade** open the release notes and the upgrade steps.

**Old links:**

- `/settings/on-its-own` opens **Your Executive**. `/settings/act-as-me` opens **Delegate → Act as me**.
- Old one-page links still work: `/settings#executive` and `#on-its-own` open Your Executive, `#memory` About you, `#workspace` Workspace, `#tools` Advanced, `#about` About, and `#act-as-me` Delegate → Act as me.

*Tip: if you're looking for a feature that isn't in the sidebar, it's probably under **Settings → Advanced**. The account menu (the **⋯** next to your name at the bottom of the sidebar) has **User Guide**, **Pause or resume the Executive** and, when you signed in with an account, **Sign out**.*
